description: The acceptance criteria of the root issues #1417 to #1421 (#28 D1). Root and child issues refer to a criterion by its id and do not restate its threshold. truealpha_contracts.goal_criteria holds the backing checks equal to tools/nightly_verdicts.json and the criterion test markers.

criteria.statement: No environment table, schedule rule or vendor share exists outside environment_contract.v1.json and its generated outputs. A hand mirror makes a test fail.
CI calls the same make targets as the laptop, and a broken target fails ci-required. infra2 renders from the manifest inside the deployed image.
Staging and production deploy through one mechanism, and no deploy starts while a long Dagster job runs.
criteria.threshold: 0 failures in 30 consecutive deploys; production at most 1 failure in its last 10 deploys

criteria.statement: Local defaults are diff-scoped. Pushes stay fast and few defects escape them.
criteria.threshold: p90 per push at most 60 s; escape rate at most 5%

criteria.statement: The delivery cadence stays inside its control limits.
criteria.threshold: 10 to 15 PRs and 3 to 4 staging runs per production tag

criteria.statement: Every check declares its tier, cost and retirement condition. A check with no catch in 90 days and a non-zero cost is proposed for deletion.
criteria.threshold: 0 checks without tier, cost and retirement condition

criteria.statement: Production promotion requires the staging journey verdict green on the same SHA. An issue closes on the runtime verdict of its capability on the served SHA.
criteria.threshold: 0 promotions without a green staging journey verdict on that SHA

criteria.statement: CI boots the release images with the infra2-rendered environment, replays migrations under a concurrent long transaction and dry-runs the tag path.
criteria.threshold: a branch that reintroduces #1369, #1377 or the 2026-10-15 replay lock fails CI

criteria.statement: A merged PR reaches staging and production through the pipeline with no manual repair, and production promotes a verified staging tag.

The S&P 500 is the next production tier after TOPT and QQQ. It starts when its unlock holds: QQQ runs end to end on production, and the verdict fetch_keys_once is green for 3 consecutive nights (the unlock in environment_contract.v1.json). From then on, a production S&P 500 head advances every scheduled day. Each tick is complete or names every missing cell by reason.
criteria.threshold: every scheduled day after the unlock

criteria.statement: No fetch key is fetched twice per environment per day.
Every seat's daily spend stays within its derived share, and no core-path key ends deferred_capacity.
criteria.threshold: 0 days over the share; 0 core-path keys deferred

criteria.statement: Every production price has two origins or a named reason, and the corroborated share shows its interval.
criteria.threshold: every price has two origins or a named reason

criteria.statement: Every listing resolves to its primary exchange through the identity store. AAPL has one key across TOPT, QQQ and the S&P 500.
The risk-free rate and consensus growth come from scheduled sources with lineage.
Sampled production values trace through snapshot and observation to raw.fetches bytes whose sha256 matches the stored object.
criteria.threshold: at least 20 sampled values per night; 0 mismatches

criteria.statement: A test registers a new source for an existing semantic type and runs capture to mart with no change to generic code.
criteria.threshold: 0 changes to generic capture, snapshot, factor, lineage or consumer code

criteria.statement: For every seat, the p99 busy-season daily demand stays within UTILIZATION_CEILING (environment_contract.py) of its derived share, and rate-limited lanes finish inside their windows.
criteria.window: busy season (10-K season and earnings weeks)

criteria.statement: The real limits of Yahoo and the LLM plan, the VPS disk headroom and the per-issuer tick compute time are recorded with date and method, and the plan uses them.

The memory cgroup of the Dagster code server, which holds every run and the gRPC server, shows no OOM kill and a peak within UTILIZATION_CEILING (environment_contract.py) of its ceiling. The run limit of dagster.yaml is the declared number of slots, and the budget of one run process derives from the declared ceiling and the size of the server.
criteria.threshold: 0 OOM kills; peak within UTILIZATION_CEILING of memory.max

criteria.statement: The S&P 500 membership comes from the IVV N-PORT holdings, resolved to listings through the identity store. No other source writes it.
The production TOPT and QQQ ticks run on schedule and land a head, and each fetch key is fetched once. Missing cells carry a named reason, and no seat exceeds its share.
Every module serves a value with its confidence score for every applicable sentinel in staging and production.
criteria.pending_on: #1416 E4 (the verdicts read the TOPT and QQQ heads, not the sentinel set)

criteria.statement: Every sentinel known answer passes nightly in staging and production, including the negative classification answers. A stored value changed by 10x makes the oracle fail.
Numbers are compared across origins and classifications against a labelled sample. The 95% upper bound of the error rate stays at or below 1%.
criteria.threshold: at least 600 compared values; 95% upper bound of the error rate at most 1%

criteria.statement: PEG serves at least two conventions (historical and consensus), and the App and MCP can switch between them.
A refused issuer does not roll back the other issuers of the deployed tick.
Module usable coverage on the production S&P 500 meets the objective that the environment contract declares.
criteria.threshold: the coverage objective of the environment contract

criteria.statement: Scheduled jobs inside each environment compute C1, C2, C3 and C6 and write them to mart.
criteria.threshold: 0 criteria evidenced only by a laptop or CI run

criteria.statement: Every module has a value for every applicable sentinel in production. The sentinel oracles run nightly and report pass or a named failure, with no false red.
A new formula is one JSON change: a test adds a tree and rows appear with no migration and no Python change.
A variant definition runs through the CLI and the job. Its results bind the definition hash and appear on /research/backtest, and the live run does not change.
N overrides produce N runs.
A ticker or theme absent from every universe is added by a contract or registry change only and reaches staging rows.
Backtest history covers at least 60 months with total return from explicit corporate actions.
The LookAheadError guard has a mutation test, and every backtest run asserts that each consumed input was knowable before its cutoff.
The backtest window is a parameter of the strategy definition, not a code constant or a run option. The default is 12 quarterly cutoffs (36 months) now. The ideal state is 20 years (240 months).
criteria.threshold: window set by the definition; default 12 quarterly cutoffs; ideal 240 months

criteria.statement: The nightly backtest of the live definition is green in production, and one variant definition runs once from the CLI with its own definition hash.
An unauthenticated MCP call returns 401 on staging and production in every release walk.
No deployed module imports or subclasses a Fixture class.
App, MCP and card read every module field through one mart read view per consumer shape on the served head. No consumer selects those shapes from base tables.
An MCP tool returns a rendered report and a card image, and the card is saved to /research/library.
/admin shows freshness, completeness, correctness, nightly verdicts and backup and restore age, with no false red.
uv run python tools/vision_audit.py --env production prints every criterion of Roots 1 to 5 with a verdict.

Per environment, per night and per sentinel, one view over verdict rows shows: bytes landed with sha256, every module on the served head, lineage to bytes, App equal to MCP and card, known answers and a backtest bound to the head.
criteria.pending_on: #1421 E7 (the journey view, the lineage sample and the known answers)

criteria.statement: The canonical questions run through MCP tools every night, and a real LLM client walks them every week. Each answer cites filing and vintage and equals the App value.
criteria.window: every night; every week for the LLM client

criteria.statement: The owner reviews one generated Xiaohongshu deck once and records the verdict on #1421.
A verdict that has not run within its cadence or reads null shows as not proven on /admin and blocks promotion.

An LLM client answers the canonical questions for one sentinel through authenticated MCP with the App values and a lineage citation. One card is rendered and saved, and /admin shows the journey verdict.
